When the number of such walks is sufficiently large, this process can, in principle, reconstruct the underlying document-level knowledge graph in a reverse manner. This idea is conceptually aligned with prior work on QA generation based on knowledge graphs in web search agent Li et al. ( 2025b , a ) . We do not explicitly construct a document-level knowledge graph in advance, as such an approach would incur substantial engineering complexity and overhead. Instead, our method adopts a more lightweight design that is nevertheless capable of generating challenging DocQA pairs, achieving a better trade-off between efficiency and effectiveness.
